title: CloudPilot AI generic billing export
description: One CSV data row. Values are strings in the CSV; numeric fields are validated as exact decimals and never as floats. Extra columns are permitted and retained in raw row data.

account_id.description: Masked/demo identifier. 12-digit account numbers are masked to ****1234 before storage.

environment.description: Blank is normalized to 'unknown'; invalid values are rejected.

usage_quantity.description: Exact decimal, >= 0, <= 1e15, stored with 6 decimal places (HALF_UP).

usage_unit.description: Unknown but well-formed units are accepted with a warning.

cost_amount.description: Exact decimal, >= 0, <= 1e12, stored with 6 decimal places (HALF_UP). Negative credits are not supported yet.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Must be in the configured allowlist (default USD,EUR,GBP,INR,CAD,AUD). Multiple currencies in one file raise a warning; they are never summed together.

tag_team.description: Blank is normalized to 'untagged' with a warning.

tag_owner.description: Blank is normalized to 'unassigned' with a warning.
